name: claude-skills
description: Agent Skills for Claude Code by Judson Neer, published as individually installable plugins

plugins.name: create-skill
plugins.description: Build a new Claude Code skill, or restructure an existing one, using progressive disclosure. Covers naming, writing a description that actually triggers, splitting content into bundled files versus scripts, and verifying a skill fires.

plugins.name: draw-architecture-diagram
plugins.description: Draw cloud architecture and data-flow diagrams as draw.io XML the way Judson Neer lays them out: one boundary, layers from users to business logic to data to background jobs, external systems around the edge. Includes the recurring draw.io style strings.

plugins.name: style-of-the-faith
plugins.description: Visual identity for the Church of the Incandescent Filaments: named palette, typography, and color roles, centralized so deck, document, and artifact skills share one source of truth.

plugins.name: update-documentation
plugins.description: Reviews and updates a repo's documentation (README.md, CLAUDE.md, and any other docs) against the current code, using a subagent so the review stays out of the main context.

plugins.name: write-as-jud
plugins.description: Write prose in Judson Neer's voice: emails and blog posts from a shared core voice, plus companion skills for proposals, estimates, feedback and reviews, and interview and 1-on-1 agendas, with an advisory linter for mechanical tells. Published as a worked example of a personal voice skill; fork it and redo the analysis on your own writing.

plugins.name: write-readme
plugins.description: Write README files in Judson Neer's house style: short, Prerequisites/Usage/To-Do/References structure, linked tools, flat caveats, no marketing. A worked example of a personal documentation style; fork it and redo the analysis on your own repos.
